bias.en: Neutral · short-term pause in an uptrend
bias.zh: 中性 · 上升趋势中的短线停顿

read.en: Bloom Energy's medium trend is up: price is above the 30-day ($265) and 100-day ($254) averages, and the 30-day has climbed 9% in two weeks. The short term has stalled. The stock slipped below its 5 and 10-day averages, MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 8, and Parabolic SAR flipped bearish the same day after the Oct 6 push to $301 failed. RSI at 54 is neutral.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 中期趋势向上：股价位于 30 日（$265）与 100 日（$254）均线上方，30 日线两周内上升 9%。短线陷入停顿：股价跌破 5 日和 10 日均线，MACD 于 10月8日下穿信号线，10月6日冲击 $301 失败后抛物线 SAR 同日转空。RSI 54 属中性。

read.en: Bulls need a close back above $286–292 (the short averages and Oct 7 high) and then $301–305, which has capped the stock since May. Support is the 30-day average and Oct 8 low at about $265, then $249, a level that has held six times since August. Daily swings near 7% make this a stock for smaller positions.
read.zh: 多方需先收盘站回 $286–292（短期均线与10月7日高点），再突破 5月以来压制股价的 $301–305。支撑为 30 日均线及 10月8日低点（约 $265），其次 $249（8月以来六次守住）。日均波幅接近 7%，宜控制仓位。

r.en: Oct 6 high; capped the stock since May
